title: Global Uniqueness for the Smooth Isotropic Elasticity Inverse Problem
summary: We prove that the full static displacement-to-traction map uniquely determines both real smooth Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ 3 , provided μ > 0 and $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$ on the closure. This resolves the smooth three-dimensional isotropic elastic Calderón uniqueness problem under these positivity assumptions.
family_title: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity

review.reason: Proves uniqueness of smooth Lamé moduli from the static displacement-to-traction map.
